outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic paired with raw western blot images (blot); it contains no averaged plot data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Bar charts quantify densitometry from the single western blots shown in panel A (no error bars/replicate indication), representing single measured values per antibody rather than an average across replicates, so overlaid individual points are not required.
This is a heatmap of protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Violin plots already display the full data distribution, so individual points are not required.
Bar chart shows mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate data points (circles) overlaid on each bar for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatterplots inherently display individual data points, so this check is exempt.
Scatterplot showing individual IP-MS experiment values; individual points are inherently the data shown.
PCA scatterplot; each point represents an individual sample, exempt from this check.
PCA scatterplots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum); each point represents an individual sample, exempt from this check.
